WHERE ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_stability.value AS phase_stability,
  cp_mismatch.value AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS c11,
  cp_c12.value AS c12,
  cp_c44.value AS c44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stability ON cp_stability.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_mismatch ON cp_mismatch.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND cp_stability.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_mismatch.property_name = 'lattice_mismatch'
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
  AND cp_stability.value <= 0.05
  AND ABS(cp_mismatch.value) <= 0.02
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
  AND (cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) > 0
ORDER BY cp_stability.value ASC, ABS(cp_mismatch.value) ASC, cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_stability.value AS energy_above_hull,
  ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_bulk.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    0.4 * (1.0 / (1.0 + cp_stability.value)) +
    0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57))) +
    0.3 * (cp_bulk.value / (cp_bulk.value + 100.0))
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stability ON cp_stability.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_stability.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
JOIN calculated_property cp_lattice ON cp_lattice.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_lattice.property_name = 'lattice_a'
JOIN calculated_property cp_bulk ON cp_bulk.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_bulk.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (
    m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ni(-|$)'
    OR m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Co(-|$)'
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.chemical_system,
  COUNT(*) AS material_count,
  AVG(cp.value) AS avg_stability_value
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
GROUP BY m.chemical_system
ORDER BY avg_stability_value ASC, material_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (cp_bm.value / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) AS ranking_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_stable.value = 1
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ranking_score DESC, lattice_diff ASC, bulk_modulus DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS c11,
  cp_c12.value AS c12,
  cp_c44.value AS c44,
  cp_stab.value AS stability_value
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_a ON cp_a.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stab ON cp_stab.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp_a.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'C12'
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'C44'
  AND cp_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
ORDER BY
  cp_stab.value ASC,
  ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57) ASC,
  (cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_lattice.value AS lattice_a,
  ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_bulk.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lattice ON cp_lattice.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
LEFT JOIN calculated_property cp_bulk ON cp_bulk.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_bulk.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_stable.value = 1
  AND cp_l12.property_name = 'is_l12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_lattice.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND (
    m.chemical_system = 'Co'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Co-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Co-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Co'
    OR m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END,
  ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57) ASC,
  cp_bulk.value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'Q1: low formation energy / stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 THEN 'Q2: low formation energy / metastable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'Q3: high formation energy / stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 THEN 'Q4: high formation energy / metastable'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY stability_quadrant, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       cp_lat.value AS lattice_a,
       ABS(cp_lat.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lat ON cp_lat.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_l12 ON cp_l12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stable ON cp_stable.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.chemical_system <> 'Al-Ni'
  AND cp_lat.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_l12.property_name = 'prototype_L12'
  AND cp_l12.value = 1
  AND cp_stable.property_name = 'is_stable'
  AND cp_stable.value = 1
ORDER BY ABS(cp_lat.value - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN e.atomic_number BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '3d'
    WHEN e.atomic_number BETWEEN 39 AND 48 THEN '4d'
    WHEN e.atomic_number BETWEEN 72 AND 80 THEN '5d'
  END AS a_site_transition_metal_series,
  c.element AS a_site,
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN element e ON e.symbol = c.element
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND (
    e.atomic_number BETWEEN 21 AND 30
    OR e.atomic_number BETWEEN 39 AND 48
    OR e.atomic_number BETWEEN 72 AND 80
  )

  (
    0.4 * CASE WHEN ps.is_stable THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END

    + 0.3 * (cp.value / (cp.value + 300.0))
  ) AS weighted_score

JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id

SELECT
  RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY
      (
        (CASE
          WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
          ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0), 0.0))
        END)
        * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
        * (CASE
          WHEN cp11.value > ABS(cp12.value)
           AND cp44.value > 0
           AND cp11.value + 2.0 * cp12.value > 0
          THEN 1.0
          ELSE 0.0
        END)
      ) DESC
  ) AS score_rank,
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp11.value AS c11,
  cp12.value AS c12,
  cp44.value AS c44,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
    ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0), 0.0))
  END AS stability_score,
  1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_matching_score,
  CASE
    WHEN cp11.value > ABS(cp12.value)
     AND cp44.value > 0
     AND cp11.value + 2.0 * cp12.value > 0
    THEN 1.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS elastic_score,
  (
    (CASE
      WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
      ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0), 0.0))
    END)
    * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    * (CASE
      WHEN cp11.value > ABS(cp12.value)
       AND cp44.value > 0
       AND cp11.value + 2.0 * cp12.value > 0
      THEN 1.0
      ELSE 0.0
    END)
  ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp11 ON calc.calculation_id = cp11.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp12 ON calc.calculation_id = cp12.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp44 ON calc.calculation_id = cp44.calculation_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
  AND cp11.tensor_component = 'C11'
  AND cp12.tensor_component = 'C12'
  AND cp44.tensor_component = 'C44'

LIMIT 10000;

  cp_c12.value AS C12,
  cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    (cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant' AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11')
    OR cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
  )
  AND (
    (cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant' AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12')
    OR cp_c12.property_name = 'C12'
  )
  AND (
    (cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant' AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44')
    OR cp_c44.property_name = 'C44'
  )
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
  AND cp_c11.value + 2 * cp_c12.value > 0
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, cp_c44.value DESC

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
ORDER BY transition_metal_group ASC,
         c.element ASC,
         ps.is_stable DESC,
         ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND ps.energy_above_hull < (
      SELECT ps_ref.energy_above_hull
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      ORDER BY ps_ref.energy_above_hull ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    formula,
    is_stable,
    energy_above_hull,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_diff,
    C11,
    C12,
    C44,
    stability_score,
    lattice_match_score,
    elastic_score,
    stability_score * lattice_match_score * elastic_score AS composite_score
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.formula,
        ps.is_stable,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        s.lattice_a,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
        cp_c11.value AS C11,
        cp_c12.value AS C12,
        cp_c44.value AS C44,
        CASE
            WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0))
        END AS stability_score,
        1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_match_score,
        CASE
            WHEN cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
             AND cp_c44.value > 0
             AND cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value > 0
            THEN (cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) / 3.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS elastic_score
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
    WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
) ranked
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  c.element AS a_site,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;
